evals.name: seaway-sea-reefer-full
evals.prompt:
Dry run (don't write to Airtable yet, just show me the mapped record + summary). Capture this freight quote:

From: Nathan Borg <nathan.borg@seaway.com.au>
Date: 28 May 2026
Subject: Reefer quote Adelaide > Jebel Ali

Hi Gareth,
Pleased to confirm the following for your fresh produce reefer shipment.

Service: Sea freight, reefer (20RE or 40RE), Adelaide to Jebel Ali via Fujairah, CFR.
Ocean freight: USD 12,500 per container.
Australian origin charges (AUD): Bill of Lading 150.00, export clearance 65.00, export docs 45.00, technology fee 14.50, PRA 35.00 — OTHC inclusive. Total AUD 309.50.
Bunker, emergency fuel, carrier security and on-carriage: all inclusive.
Excludes: marine and road insurance, destination charges, customs duties, taxes.
Validity: until 15.06.2026.

Regards, Nathan
evals.expected_output: Record mapped to Adelaide to Jebel Ali route + Seaway provider. Freight Cost 12500 USD, Origin Charges 309.50 AUD, bunker noted inclusive. Validity 2026-06-15 surfaced prominently. MISSING flagged: destination charges, marine insurance, road insurance, war risk surcharge (not separately stated), customs/duties, inland trucking, contact phone optional. Critical gaps called out. Genset: Not Applicable (no inland leg, Jebel Ali direct) or flagged. AUD conversion at a live rate with the rate noted as assumption. Pricing scenario: No, blocked on destination charges + insurance + war risk.

evals.name: seaway-air-freight-tiers
evals.prompt:
Dry run please (preview only, no Airtable write). Log this air freight quote for our premium produce:

From Ryan Harrowfield, Seaway Adelaide perishable air freight. Emirates SkyCargo, Adelaide to DXB, per kg: +100kg 5.60, +300kg 5.30, +500kg 5.15, +1000kg 4.55, +2000kg 4.50, +3000kg 4.45 (AUD/kg). Local charges: AWB 30 per shipment, terminal doc 80 per shipment, screening 0.12/kg (min 60), plus handling/security/inspection fees. We're looking at roughly 500kg. Valid to 13 June 2026.
evals.expected_output: Air freight method, no reefer/genset (Not Applicable). Container Type = air weight tier (+500kg = AUD 5.15/kg). No canonical sea route -> Route left blank and flagged (air to DXB). Provider Seaway (Ryan Harrowfield). Base rate captured for the 500kg tier; locals noted. Validity 2026-06-13. MISSING: insurance, customs, destination/handling itemisation maybe. Genset Not Applicable. AUD already, no conversion needed. Pricing scenario assessment given.
